Contact
# Let's talk about your project.

The fastest way to reach Totono is by email. Write to [toni.tralice@totono.xyz](mailto:toni.tralice@totono.xyz) and you will get a reply from Toni Tralice, the engineer who would actually work on your project, usually within two business days.

## What to include

- A short description of what you want to build or improve.
- Your current stack, if there is one, and who maintains it today.
- Any deadlines, budget range or constraints we should know about.
- The best way and time to reach you for a follow-up call.

## What happens next

After a first exchange over email we usually schedule a short call to understand the problem in more depth. From there you receive a written proposal with scope, timeline and pricing. There is no cost or obligation for this initial conversation.

## Business details

TOTONO LLC is a limited liability company registered in Delaware, United States. We work remotely with clients across the Americas and Europe. Email is the only official channel; we do not use contact forms or social media direct messages for business enquiries.
